decisions.capability: Route native Claude Workflow stages to lean task-matched project agents with explicit model, effort and deferred named tool lanes, and size each workflow to its task
decisions.evidence_scope: On one identical task the provider-returned first prompt fell from 42,396 tokens (default child) to 12,164 (named MCP grants behind ToolSearch) and 8,048 (source-scout); eight native review-changes runs, two readiness audits, one builder run and one Codex cross-family review are retained as sanitized receipts; the portable copies were adopted into a scratch project and run natively under the full host profile with the observational layer recorded; the project-only profile was not qualified (provider errors, then a permission-layer refusal of the Workflow tool).
limitations: First-prompt figures bound one tiny task on one host and model; they are not a savings rate.
Haiku is not routed on one packet and one Opus verifier (Sonnet 14/14 lane rows, Haiku 9/14 with a misattributed quote).
The review workflow's strict accepted status was never returned during the deployment; the gate was fix-and-commit after independent review.

Local suites are stubbed or synthetic; only the native runs and the Prometheus deltas are provider evidence. Per-session scoping of the exported metric is unavailable by design (the collector keeps no session id on metrics), so observational deltas are host-wide time windows with concurrent activity declared.
Codex agent examples inherit model and effort and have no end-to-end run of their own.

The project-only settings profile is not qualified: three provider errors and, with the coordinator model pinned, a permission-layer refusal of the Workflow tool; headless runs need a loaded settings source whose permission mode or allow rule covers the Workflow tool.
decisions.next_gap: Overturn only on evidence: Haiku after a repeat trial with no unanchored citation on two distinct extraction packets; the unrestricted guideline if recorded runs exceed their independent units or pause on fan-out rate limits; a one-hour child cache class only for a child that idles more than five minutes between requests; the Codex agent examples after a task-level run of their own.

decisions.capability: Maintain useful scoped memory across native Codex and Claude
decisions.evidence_scope: Nine current repository sources reviewed; native learning, scheduler admission, unchanged upstream tests and real client outcome capture are recorded separately. Existing code/document/context retrieval remain complementary layers.
limitations: Scheduler covers all store scopes, with a per-project limit and once-per-session claims; current deployment has one adopted project.
Assistant excerpts are sanitized and capped, not complete transcripts. Claude prompt capture remains opted out.
Model review rejected insufficient evidence; scheduler admission did not establish learned-write quality. Exact memory lifetime token savings remain unknown.
Alternative systems are research candidates, not installed or locally benchmarked winners.
decisions.next_gap: Evaluate real subsequent learned proposals and representative retrieval quality before changing the accepted memory of record.

decisions.capability: Resolve persistent native command and MCP environments
decisions.evidence_scope: Fresh native processes resolved selected commands/MCP servers and Claude startup hooks; restarted Desktop source retrieval has its own dated receipt.
limitations: Configuration presence does not prove an already-running task hot-reloaded it.
The Linux/WSL and Desktop process/configuration boundaries remain distinct.
decisions.next_gap: Collect the specific new-host or changed-session activation evidence; do not copy account stores.

decisions.capability: Resume the same native session after an owned interruption
decisions.evidence_scope: Codex on Mac and Claude on WSL resumed the same session to finish an unchanged single checkpoint; later bounded source tasks also retained continuations.
limitations: Individual session continuation does not establish arbitrary worker crash, provider cancellation or whole-host recovery.
Resumed cumulative usage must not be added again to earlier included totals.
decisions.next_gap: The separate native-child-interruption-recovery decision covers one abrupt writing-worker failure with a single local effect; qualify changed effects or another host before extending acceptance.

decisions.capability: Use native client tools to retrieve exact project evidence
decisions.evidence_scope: Both signed-in native clients completed the bounded source-retrieval tasks; the final receipt also retains scoped continuation and observation results.
limitations: Earlier refused MCP calls, Claude format failures and source-host account limits remain recorded.
Successful retrieval does not qualify every installed tool, all prompts, another PC or complete causal token savings.
decisions.next_gap: Verify changed native process/tool activation on the intended host; retain failed attempts.

decisions.capability: Render the configured HUD in a native Claude terminal
decisions.evidence_scope: The retained foundation-closure native PTY observations show configured claude-hud 0.8.0 in Claude 2.1.278 before and after a bounded review, including model, project, context and usage fields. This catalog reconciliation reuses those observations without a new terminal or model run. Earlier onboarding and effort-overlay attempts remain retained.
limitations: Evidence for the visible statusline is the original coordinator's screen observations and independent installed-plugin audit, separate from the native context export.
Not every HUD statistic, exact billing reconciliation, Windows Terminal dropdown interaction, automatic compaction or new-host activation was qualified.
decisions.next_gap: Verify target-host activation or a specific untested statistic only when that capability is needed; reuse the accepted recorded rendering scope.

decisions.evidence_scope: One native inherited-tool child completed cancellation, same-child continuation, abrupt parent-runtime failure, automatic systemd descendant cleanup and same-parent/same-child finalization with an unchanged checkpoint and one local effect.
limitations: One synthetic local task on this WSL host; not general worker reliability or an OS sandbox.

Restricted Bash-only role incompatibility and every original failure remain retained; only this inherited role is accepted.
The successful run did not request ls, so the exact rewrite permission diagnosis is deterministic evidence rather than an exercised native approval success.
Native usage views overlap; initial SIGKILL has no terminal record. Complete parent/child/retry usage, billing and savings remain unknown.
decisions.next_gap: Reuse the accepted same-host fixture while inputs match; qualify changed application effects or an independent host only when that scope is required.

decisions.capability: Replay and resume a native Claude Workflow after selected-worker stop and graceful coordinator exit
decisions.evidence_scope: Existing local invoice fixture: selected reviewer stop retained a failed child and null result; replay reused completed implementation, graceful native exit cleaned observed processes, and same-session resume integrated the repair while preserving later user edits. Independent 29 visible and seven hidden checks passed.
limitations: This is a local integration fixture, not an unchanged upstream product test or general reliability benchmark.
The separate writing comparison passed code checks but both arms retained procedural failures; the Workflow arm used more reported tokens.
Recovery native cumulative usage exceeds deduplicated persisted usage by 205701 tokens; complete accounting remains unresolved.
Hard crash, physical-host reboot, remote provider cancellation and external exactly-once effects are unqualified.
decisions.next_gap: Reuse the accepted graceful-recovery fixture; qualify a representative application or a different failure/effect boundary only when required.

decisions.capability: Implement a bounded repair through an owned native child
decisions.evidence_scope: One foreground native Opus child repaired the owned file; twelve frozen tests and independent exhaustive checks passed.
limitations: One successful child task does not establish arbitrary delegation quality, crash recovery or total workflow efficiency.
decisions.next_gap: Use the separately recorded native-child-interruption-recovery decision for its accepted inherited-role fixture; qualify a different task or effect before extending that claim.

existing_overturn_when: A real task needs durable multi-host state, approval waits or effect recovery beyond native workers, and one challenger passes frozen cancellation, replay, ownership and integration cases.
limitations: Graceful native Workflow resume is separate from the systemd child-crash fixture; neither transfers every hard-crash guarantee to the other.
The restricted reviewer tool profile is not the accepted inherited-tool lane. The older companion backend acceptance does not certify every outer plugin invocation.
Native model/effort settings are inherited and returned identities recorded. Skill propagation is not a universal runtime/model ranking; account scopes and failed read paths remain evidence.

The September 21 New York / September 22 UTC source refresh adds Deep Agents, OpenHands SDK/Agent Canvas, Microsoft Agent Framework and DeerFlow comparisons. It does not install them or establish a head-to-head worker winner; historical DeerFlow adapter evidence applies only to its recorded revision.
requirement: Delegate bounded independent work, preserve owned edits and actual failed results, and integrate only after relevant review.
rules: Judge from retained evidence. Open the evidence_refs of every adopted candidate (bounded: the referenced file or its relevant section) and record every path you opened in sources_read. Do not rely on memory of the repositories.

The winner set is 1-3 adopted candidates (adopted == true) that best satisfy the requirement on the evidence. why_selected must cite at least one evidence path and state what was actually observed (native execution, measured comparison, local integration, synthetic fixture or source review), not what the project claims.
Every adopted non-winner candidate appears in alternatives with a why_not_default that states the concrete evidence gap or trade-off; add non-adopted candidates only with the same standard.

If a non-adopted candidate would satisfy the requirement better on the evidence, do not select it: record it in challenger_preferred with the comparison (a fixtures/, blueprints/ or tests/ path, or a python3/node command) that would establish it. Agreement between lanes never promotes; only an executed comparison can.

overturn_when names the concrete check that would change the verdict (a fixtures/, blueprints/ or tests/ path or a runnable python3/node command). open_gaps lists what the evidence does not establish. limits lists what you could not read or verify. Do not invent paths, numbers or results; leave evidence_refs empty rather than guess.
